m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: Original historical M6 I/J input receipt reports phase_b_replayed=false and does not certify the final exact approved 100. The October15 locked list changed in exactly eight commander-first one-for-one swaps: Consultation/Minor Misstep, Drake/Counterbalance, Opposition Agent/Last Chance, Devil/Storm-Kiln Artist, Claws/Copy Enchantment, Snuff Out/Dispel, Marsh Flats/Great Hall, Sink MDFC/Tolaria; Birgi front/full face is the same Oracle card. All five P0 blueprint IDs and relevant P1 bounded predicates were re-executed on final exact SHA with current 100/100 Scryfall snapshot and GitHub Actions. Historical global I/J replay and comprehensive game-engine test are not invented; K6, E2 and W2 are explicit source-specific P1 deferrals with limited coverage, not passing simulations.

P0.payable_fixture: Marchesa present, targeted opposing permanent, one colorless mana in pool, actual four-card library.
P0.positive_assertion: One paid trigger spends {1}, moves one top-two card to hand and one to graveyard, conserving card objects.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Zero mana declines resolution choice and removed commander prevents trigger.

P0.payable_fixture: Target one or multiple opponent/opp-owned objects with a single spell or activation; Marchesa present with {1}.
P0.positive_assertion: Several targets within one event commit one crime; one optional {1} may select top two.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Self targeting and no-target events do not count; no multiplication of trigger for multi-target spell.

P0.payable_fixture: Hex Parasite with X=0, opponent permanent target, pay phyrexian symbol as two life from ten life, plus {1} Marchesa.
P0.positive_assertion: X=0 leaves zero counters removed but target exists; player pays 2 life, separate {1}, and gets Marchesa selection.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Target own permanent gives no crime; no free unpaid selection.

P0.payable_fixture: Two independent Spatial Binding activations target opposing permanent, 1 life each from ten plus separate Marchesa {1} each.
P0.positive_assertion: Two source-paid activations yield two crimes and two paid selections, leaving 8 life and zero of two mana.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Target own permanent gives no crime/selection; 1 life remains a required cost.

P0.payable_fixture: Scrabbling Claws exact target card in opponent grave, one mana available for Marchesa; explicit Brain Freeze target.
P0.positive_assertion: Targeted Claws grave-card exile commits a crime and removes exact card from grave; paid Marchesa selection available.
P0.adversarial_assertion: If grave card leaves before resolution, it cannot be exiled twice and Breach recursion line cannot simply ignore hate.

P1.payable_fixture: Blue spell cast by any player; Lapis Lazuli Talisman trigger targets an opponent permanent, separate {1} for Marchesa.
P1.positive_assertion: Declining optional {3} to untap target does not erase initial targeting crime; pays Marchesa {1}.
P1.adversarial_assertion: No blue spell yields no Lapis triggered target; optional {3} not confused with commander cost.

P1.payable_fixture: Tezzeret zero loyalty targets opposing artifact/creature; legal noncreature spell triggers Kitten blink into a new object.
P1.positive_assertion: First object and new object each can activate its own once-per-turn loyalty ability, each targeted crime separately paid.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Without new object/Kitten legal trigger, same planeswalker object cannot activate twice in that turn.

P1.payable_fixture: Magda legendary red, Marchesa legendary UBR, Amber activation, first crime produces Magda Treasure tapped.
P1.positive_assertion: Amber colors are derived from controlled legendary permanents; Magda's Treasure is tapped and once per turn.
P1.adversarial_assertion: No legendary permanent means Amber produces no mana; second same-turn crime produces no second Magda Treasure.

P1.payable_fixture: Marchesa in play, three {1} mana, Claws opponent target, Devil sacrifice trigger opposing target, Drake opposing creature ETB target.
P1.positive_assertion: Three independent crimes can pay Marchesa three times, moving three hand cards and three grave cards from six top cards.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Drake without opposing legal creature cannot claim crime; source activation and creature presence matter.

P1.payable_fixture: Oracle ETB trigger on stack, paid Demonic Consultation names absent card, library emptied, devotion at least cards remaining.
P1.positive_assertion: Oracle trigger after paid library exile sees zero library with qualifying devotion and may win.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Opponent counters Oracle trigger or prevents actual exile; invalid stack/window does not claim win.

P1.payable_fixture: Equipped Aphetto Alchemist untapped and able to tap (not summoning sick); Bow tapped trigger and untap ability.
P1.positive_assertion: Three sequential tap/untap cycles deal three damage to each opponent under the bounded example.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Cursed Totem shutting off Alchemist or summoning sickness/no equip prevents that example; Bow damage is not a crime.

P1.payable_fixture: Marchesa absent from battlefield; opposing spell targeted, five generic mana in pool.
P1.positive_assertion: Target event is still a crime, but no Marchesa trigger is generated and no mana spent.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Cannot treat a removed Marchesa as an on-board source of top-two selection.

P1.payable_fixture: Historic approved October15 100 vs current exact 100, normalize Birgi full/front face Oracle identity.
P1.positive_assertion: Preserve 92 actual strategic names, exchange exactly eight; do not revive obsolete historical 48-card rebuild.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Do not claim original M5 reconstruction or long-past case oracle as newly executed wins.

P1.coverage_consequence: No claim that current list supports two simultaneous extra turns or that the obsolete Last Chance case was mechanically executed as an included-card combo.

P1.specific_reason: Static UBR pip/fast-mana checks and full current 100 legality ran, but no full seven-card hand sampled probability or exhaustive source-paid first-three-turn ramp/draw simulation was executed.
P1.coverage_consequence: No quantitative Marchesa turn-three cast probability, colored-pip consistency percentage or measured cEDH advantage is certified.

P1.specific_reason: Current Oracle of Breach/LED/Brain Freeze and a bounded graveyard-hate negative assertion are checked, but full payable recursive escape/storm stack, card-zone conservation across a terminal multiplayer kill and opponent response windows are not executed in a general rules engine.
P1.coverage_consequence: The Breach win is a legal known synergy and remains in the deck, but this revision's test suite does not certify a fully reconstructed end-to-end payable loop under arbitrary table interaction.
